memories.content: The Chair is responsible for setting the committee's agenda and scheduling public hearings. They are aware of the sixty-day window for scheduling a hearing on the rail franchise bill. The Chair has not yet decided whether to schedule a hearing.

The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee is considering the rail franchise bill. The committee's rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The bill was referred to the committee on 2026-07-15, so the window ends on 2026-09-13. The committee has not yet scheduled a hearing as of the simulation start time.
